newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU experts back avoparcin ban in feed.
newsitem.headline: EU experts back avoparcin ban in feed.

text.p: The European Union's standing foodstuffs committee has backed a Commission proposal to ban the use of the drug avoparcin in animal feed, a European Commission spokesman said on Thursday.

"The committee voted by an overwhelming majority in favour of the ban which can now be decided by written proceedure in the Commission possibly over the Christmas period," spokesman Gerard Kiely said.
Avoparcin, marketed as Avotan, is made by Roche-UK, part of Roche Holding AG, and is used in pig feed to enhance food conversion.
The committee said that the ban was a precautionary measure needed because there was evidence of a build up of resistance to antibiotics in pigs.
"It is not certain what is causing the build-up and there is to be further research and a two year monitoring period before the ban is reviewed in December 1998," an expert said.
